marketEvidence.What It Signals: AI hiring in India's IT sector rose 16% YoY in June 2026 while overall IT recruitment declined 3%.
marketEvidence.How It Changes Your Plan: Prioritize AI-specific skills while maintaining software fundamentals.

marketEvidence.What It Signals: 58 open positions; building foundational models and enterprise-grade systems.
marketEvidence.How It Changes Your Plan: Use Sarvam as a benchmark for Indian frontier-AI skill requirements.

marketEvidence.What It Signals: Applied AI Engineer roles exist in Bangalore; broader roles span AI research/engineering.
marketEvidence.How It Changes Your Plan: Target applied AI as the realistic near-term layer; use frontier roles as a long-term benchmark.

marketEvidence.What It Signals: Applied AI work involves technical infrastructure and deployment of Claude in domain workflows.
marketEvidence.How It Changes Your Plan: Emphasize production AI, not just model theory.

marketEvidence.What It Signals: Applied/production-ready skills such as RAG and MLOps are highlighted as gaps.
marketEvidence.How It Changes Your Plan: Make RAG, deployment and MLOps mandatory.

marketEvidence.What It Signals: Verification/validation becomes more important as coding agents handle implementation.
marketEvidence.How It Changes Your Plan: Add evaluation, testing and agent reliability to projects.

marketEvidence.What It Signals: Anthropic announced hiring for custom AI-chip design, reflecting growing AI systems/hardware depth.
marketEvidence.How It Changes Your Plan: Keep systems/performance as a later specialization, not the immediate fresher focus.

marketEvidence.Source: Data Science Collective (Medium) - Agentic AI Engineer Roadmap 2026
marketEvidence.What It Signals: A real May-2026 Agentic AI Engineer JD lists 20+ named tools: LangGraph, MCP, A2A, RAGAS, hybrid retrieval, Qdrant/Pinecone/Weaviate, Neo4j, E2B/Modal sandboxes, Langfuse/Phoenix/Helicone observability, judge calibration, RFT/DPO/SFT fine-tuning.
marketEvidence.How It Changes Your Plan: Add named tools (not just categories) to Skills Matrix and 16-Week Plan so resume/project language matches real JDs.

marketEvidence.Source: The AI Career Lab / Digital Applied - AI Developer Hiring 2026
marketEvidence.What It Signals: Eval design is called the single biggest signal of real LLM experience, ahead of framework knowledge (LangChain/Pinecone alone reads as an outdated 2024 skillset).
marketEvidence.How It Changes Your Plan: Pull evaluation work forward - practice designing/running evals from Week 7 (RAG) and Week 9 (Agents) instead of waiting until Week 13.

marketEvidence.Source: vknowtech - AI Engineer Jobs in India 2026
marketEvidence.What It Signals: TCS, Infosys and Wipro are actively hiring engineers to migrate GPT-4o workflows to locally hosted small models (Llama 3 8B, Phi-3) via quantization and semantic caching to cut inference cost - the 'tokenomics' skill.
marketEvidence.How It Changes Your Plan: Add a dedicated cost-optimization module (quantization, semantic caching, local SLM hosting) - a high-value, India-specific differentiator vs. generic LangChain resumes.

marketEvidence.Source: Refonte Learning - Agentic AI Engineer in 2026
marketEvidence.What It Signals: Production discipline (access control, memory design, observability, cost control, deployment) is now the bar; prompt-only skills are treated as a single layer, not the job.
marketEvidence.How It Changes Your Plan: Every project deliverable must show deployment + observability + cost numbers, not just a working demo.

marketEvidence.Source: AI Shipping Labs - analysis of 1,000+ AI Engineer JDs
marketEvidence.What It Signals: Core JD themes rank: building AI systems (RAG/agents) > productionizing prototypes > evaluation and observability > operating provider APIs under real constraints.
marketEvidence.How It Changes Your Plan: Validates the existing week ordering (build -> productionize -> evaluate); keep evaluation and observability as running threads across every phase, not one isolated week.

marketEvidence.Source: Scaler / Taggd / AlmaBetter - India AI salary and demand reports
marketEvidence.What It Signals: India AI job postings requiring AI skills rose to roughly 11.7% (from 8.2%); about 1M AI/ML roles projected by end-2026 against a talent pool growing at roughly half that rate; LLM optimization, GPU acceleration and agentic workflow skills named as the fastest-rising pay drivers.
marketEvidence.How It Changes Your Plan: Confirms timeline urgency (demand outstrips supply through 2026) - keep continuous applications from Week 1 rather than waiting for 'complete' skills.
